name: Oecusse Digital Centre / Oecusse data centre initiative
developer: RAEOA Government / CMC; project partners reported as GPTBots.ai and Aurora Mobile for digital-economy platform components
notes: BusinessWire release says Oecusse will move forward with the Oecusse Digital Centre, including data centres, cloud computing, blockchain integration, gaming and AI, with CMC and RAEOA advancing joint venture arrangements. Tatoli separately reported CMC work toward Oecusse digital transformation and a data centre, but no MW capacity, exact site, or construction milestone was found.
